Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout adoption certificate redesign: Rebuild the adoption certificate step using a grid layout that displays companion artwork side-by-side with certificate attributes. (why: Adoption step has an 89s median / 1017s mean duration; a balanced visual summary helps users confirm adoption details quickly.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive pet style choice cards on story screen: Add interactive style selection choice cards to the story screen preceding path selection. (why: choose_path drop-off is 76.2% with 514s mean time; early visual style previews provide clearer expectations before path commitment.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after waiting progress screen: Move sign-in step to take place immediately after the waiting screen right before home intro presentation. (why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset when signing in prior to completion; signing in after rendering ensures state is saved.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing account pet restoration copy: Update sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that logging in saves current pets and restores previous companions. (why: 8 support tickets mentioned lost or reset pets after re-authenticating, causing account anxiety.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Compact layout for path selection screen: Switch the choose_path screen to a compact layout presenting path options clearly without extensive vertical scrolling. (why: Mean time on choose_path is long (514s); a compact layout helps users digest choices faster.)
5: [home, wait_info] Animated loading mascot on waiting screen: Add an animated progress asset component to the waiting screen during desktop mascot environment generation. (why: The waiting step (home) takes median 201s / mean 2336s; visual status indicators keep users informed during background asset loading.)
6: [adoption, layout] Card layout for custom pet photo upload: Rebuild the photo upload screen using a structured card layout with photo guidance tips. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering unexpectedly due to unguided user photo submissions.)
7: [finish, hint] System tray shortcut hint on home intro: Add a hint box on the home intro screen explaining system tray access to hide or manage desktop pets. (why: Users reported confusion after onboarding on how to hide or interact with their pet.)
8: [home, redesign] Split layout redesign for waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout displaying setup status on one side and desktop feature overviews on the other. (why: Waiting step takes a long mean time (2336s); split layout keeps users engaged while waiting for local rendering.)
